{{EventObtain|date = 29th of October 2020|event = [[Spring 2020 Event]]}} {{for|other uses of [[Bunny (Disambiguation)|Bunny]]}} {{CrateInfobox |title1 = {{Color|Bunny|Bunny Crate}} |image-static = BunnyCrateIcon.png |image-dynamic = BunnyCrateDynamic.png |type = Skin Crate |cost_tickets = 1,000 |bundle_cost = {{Robux|800}} (for 10 crates) |sale = No |rarities = {{Color|Event}} |contains = 9 |music-1 = [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Main Skincrate Opening|thumb|center|250px]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Happy Easter 2020!|Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Bunny Crate''' is an exclusive [[Crates|crate]] that was only obtainable during the [[Spring 2020 Event]] (though it was only taken offsale after the Overhaul Update). You could get one '''Bunny Crate''' for {{Tickets|1,000}} in the [[Event Store]], or ten '''Bunny Crates''' for {{Robux|800}} via the [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. The '''Bunny Crate''' yields bunny-themed skins that cannot be gotten from any other crate. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The '''Bunny Crate''' resembles the look of a pink and grey wooden box which was sealed shut. It contains gold on the inside. On its top is the standard shipping symbol indicating which side is up while on the front it had a rainbow Easter egg. It was opened with a crowbar. |Version 1 |The '''Bunny Crate''' resembled the look of a pink cardboard box with tape to seal it shut, similar to the [[Basic Crate]]. [[Golden Pyromancer]] |} ==Former Skins== {| class="light-table align-center pad-5" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:BunnyMedicIconAug25.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Unobtainable|Bunny}} |- !Tower |[[Medic]] |- !Moved to |Nothing |} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Appearance}} BunnyCrateInGame.png|Second version (6 April 2020 – 22 April 2026) {{GalleryHeader|Crate Icons}} Bunny Crate.png|First version (6 April 2020 – 22 April 2026) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} BunnyCrateCrowbar.png|Crowbar used to open the '''Bunny Crate'''. }} ==Trivia== *While the [[Spring 2020 Event]] ended on the 26th of May 2020, the '''Bunny Crate''' was still available to those who still had leftover {{Tickets|}} until the Overhaul Update. **However, the gamepass went offsale at the end of the [[Spring 2020 Event]] and you could not earn any additional {{Tickets|}} from [[Eggy Island]]. ==Update History== *'''6 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.9|Release v1.9.0]] **'''Bunny Crate''' added. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **'''Bunny Crate''' gamepass went offsale. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Bunny Crate''' made unobtainable. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **{{Bug}} {{Color|Unobtainable|Bunny}} [[Medic]] is no longer obtainable. *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **Skin rarity added. **{{Bug}} Crate opening music no longer plays. *'''28 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Crate opening music now plays. *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **Appearance changed. **Icon changed. *'''21 August 2026''' - [[v2.7.0]] **Category changed from {{Color|Event}} to {{Color|Common|Default}}. {{CrateNavBox}}
